authority_checks.gold: EBI OLS4 ChEBI:29287 label gold atom, formula Au and zero charge. This identifier does not identify Au(III) complexes or nanoparticle samples.
authority_checks.organism: NCBI efetch:119219 species Cupriavidus metallidurans and266264 CH34 strain. Only species119219 asserted in owner; supplementary TableS4 identifies AE104 as the plasmid-free derivative ofCH34.

claims.claim: Culture-associated source-assigned particles with old prepared stock
locators: Results: No appearance of gold nanoparticles in the periplasm
Methods: Bacterial strains and growth conditions
claims.limits: TEM assignment is not a new independent phase/valence or bulk product analysis; no matched cell-free/killed-cell comparison in the accepted microscopy series.
70h panelB differs from general72h methods and three-day prose; exposure/recovery arms remain separate. No population-level particle fraction, universal no-formation statement, or recovery yield.
AE104 genotype supported; speciesID does not identify derivative; other mutants not transferred to parent microscopy.

counterevidence: The accepted2024 experiment itself supplies the directly relevant commercial-stock null/damage comparison. Discussion explicitly permits alternative causal directions between toxicity and lack of nanoparticle formation. Chlorine-preparation route, chloride/hydroxide speciation and respiratory/Cu-homeostasis pathways remain hypotheses in this curated observation.
correction_search: Exact DOI correction/retraction web queries and Crossref relation/update fields checked on2026-10-14. No correction matching these two papers was returned and both Crossref relation mappings were empty; bounded search and metadata absence do not prove universal absence.

decisions.reason: Unambiguous element authority plus complete accessible2024 primary study with positive and negative outcomes.

Reith2009 and Wiesemann2013 metadata/search text inspected, but complete originals/supplements not acquired by attempted routes. Wiesemann2017 complete17page institutionalPDF read and Figures6-7/methods inspected as context, but officialSI acquisition unavailable. These earlier experiments are not imported into the accepted owner or counted as independent replications of Hirth2024.

licenses.Hirth2024: CC BY4.0 stated in originalJATS; raw artifacts still outsideGit.

licenses.authority_data: Only identifier facts summarized; source-specific terms not separately licensed for bulkredistribution.

handoff.schema_need: None: element/material context plus qualified microbial mechanism and support/partial/context_only evidence fit current contract. Quantities are prose assay conditions, not concentration-table mg/kg observations.
handoff.review: Independent native inspect/save required on exact final bytes; current owner validation passed. Batch gates and independent assessment are future at this report timestamp.

limitations: Bounded source/discovery search; no exhaustion claim.
No criticality-list membership or industrial deployment inferred.
No total elemental recovery, particle purity or mechanistic necessity asserted.
Missing older evidence does not prevent the narrower complete2024 observation, and is not reported as newly verified.
